verdict.rationale: Rainforest publishes its own API reference section, with endpoint pages such as create_merchant under /reference/. It also documents an OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification of its API, so the reference half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and the probe found no openapi.json at the common paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Create a merchant with an initial merchant application.
Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
